title.narrative: IDF Grant for National Science & Technology Policy Capacity

description.narrative: The government-executed IDF Grant will build the capacity of the National Science and Technology Development Agency in the Ministry of Science, Technology and Environment. The purpose of the Grant is to support the National Science and Technology Development Agency (NSTDA) in improving the effectiveness of the newly established National Science and Technology Policy Committee (NSTC) in developing, coordinating and evaluating a reform on the Recipients science and technology system. The activities (the Activities) for which the Grant is given are as follows: (a),,strengthening of the Recipients science and technology policy formulation process, through the establishment of a database of science and technology-related policy; (b),,strengthening of the Recipients monitoring and evaluation process for public investments in science and technology, through: (i) the development of science and technology development project proposal guidelines; (ii) the development and proposal of an evaluation methodology; and (iii) training teams who play key roles in government funding process; (c),,enhancing the capacity for internal management and human resource development within the policy research unit of NSTDA.
